backup.production_rule: restore-proved 76/76 tables; this release changes only cron.job rows (one insert, one command update) and no schema object, so the named set remains a valid restore point

forward_verification.name: monitor_job_scheduled_every_15_minutes
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from cron.job where jobname = 'job-heartbeat-monitor-every-15m' and schedule = '*/15 * * * *' and active)

forward_verification.name: turnover_verifier_job_now_sends_the_cron_secret_header
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from cron.job where jobname = 'turnover-verifier-daily' and command like '%x-cascade-cron-secret%' and command like '%functions/v1/turnover-verifier%')

forward_verification.name: no_secret_value_is_embedded_in_any_cron_command
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from cron.job where command ~ 'x-cascade-cron-secret''\s*,\s*''[^(]')

forward_verification.name: exactly_one_monitor_job
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from cron.job where jobname = 'job-heartbeat-monitor-every-15m') = 1

steps.name: restore_job_8_command
steps.action: cron.alter_job on turnover-verifier-daily with the pre-release command (plain Content-Type header, no secret); recorded in docs/validation before apply

feature_flags.name: scheduler_heartbeat_monitoring
feature_flags.required_state: effectively off until Lloyd creates Vault secret cascade_cron_shared_secret and sets edge secret CASCADE_CRON_SHARED_SECRET to the same value; until then both jobs receive 401 and nothing is delivered. Alert delivery additionally needs CH-S01 (P9 #1).

compatibility.evidence: One cron.schedule guarded by name, one cron.alter_job guarded by name and command shape. The header value is a Vault subquery evaluated at run time, so no secret is stored in cron.job. Rehearsal is NOT APPLICABLE: pg_cron is Supabase-managed and absent from any restored copy, and Postgres parses every reference to cron.job even behind a short-circuit, so the checks cannot be made tolerant; the DO block skips cleanly on a copy and the proof is the --verify-only pre-state (3 FAIL, 1 ok on 2026-09-09) followed by the post-apply 4/4.

stop_conditions: turnover-verifier-daily is missing or its command is not the expected http_post - the DO block raises
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the Vault secret must be created by Lloyd, never by an agent, and its value must never be printed
do not run migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh for this contract and treat its failure as expected; rely on --verify-only before and after
